fact_text: Searle was founded in 1965 and became a public limited company, listing through an IPO, in 1993.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: The speaker reads a long operating history as evidence of resilience, since an older company has come through events such as the 2008 crash and COVID-19.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: The speaker finds the CEO's education, certifications and pharmaceutical and health-sector background a strong fit for a drug maker, and says the CEO has led the company for about 17 years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: Searle's company secretary is an officer who represents the company in legal matters, so the speaker checks that person's certifications and experience.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: Searle's auditor is A.F. Ferguson, a Big Four member firm, which the speaker reads as lowering the chance of accounting fraud.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: Searle's EPS fell about 50% in 2022 from the prior year and fell again in 2023.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: Searle declared a loss for 2024 after a subsidiary it created at PKR 1,640 crore was sold for PKR 1,120 crore.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: The PKR 520 crore gap between the PKR 1,640 crore cost and the PKR 1,120 crore sale price was booked as a loss in Searle's accounts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: The speaker links Searle's weaker 2023 profit to a super tax on the company and to rupee depreciation that raised the cost of imported API raw materials.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: The speaker treats the subsidiary sale loss as a one-off that must be checked against the balance sheet, income statement and cash flow before judging Searle's financials.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: Searle holds a 6.3% share of the pharmaceutical market by volume, ranking second in the sector.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: Searle holds a 4.8% share of the pharmaceutical market by value, ranking fifth in the sector.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: TRG's free float rose above 90% after a promoter stake sale, and the speaker links the subsequent share price crash to heavy selling by the promoter amid a controversy.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: Aisha Steel Mills' revenue for the quarter ended September 2024 fell to PKR 458 crore from PKR 1,059 crore a year earlier.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: About 65% of Aisha Steel is held by its owners, and its sponsor injected about PKR 690 crore into the company during the crisis.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: The speaker reads a sponsor putting new money into a struggling company as a sign of commitment, and says the investor should follow the promoter rather than sell against them.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: A reputable auditor, such as a Big Four firm, has a reputation to protect and so reduces the chance of fraud, while a respected auditor's resignation before a scandal is a red flag.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: Owners should keep a majority stake in a company, since a controlling owner who sells down is less likely to run the company as its own.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: A company with a market share above 30% is treated as dominant and a green flag, though fragmented sectors such as pharma naturally have lower shares.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: A price-to-book ratio above 1 is treated as expensive and below 1 as cheap, though asset-light service and technology firms can carry high ratios without concern.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)

fact_text: When promoters sell their stake while outside investors keep buying, the speaker treats it as a warning sign, and investors should follow promoter behaviour instead.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'I Cracked the Code to PSX Stock Picking and You Won't Believe What I Found | Afaque Manzar |' (YouTube, 2024-12-18)
